title: Merchant Center & Product Catalog Diagnostic Audit

sections.executiveSummary: Feed health and product approval diagnostic across Google Merchant Center and Meta/TikTok Catalogs.
sections.overallScore: Catalog Health Score (0-100) reflecting percentage of approved, policy-compliant SKUs.
sections.findings: Product categorization accuracy, custom label distribution, and price/stock microdata synchronization.
sections.issues: Disapproved items due to policy flags, missing GTIN/MPN identifiers, or mismatched on-page pricing.
sections.recommendations: Feed enhancement proposals, supplemental feed rules, and automated inventory sync fixes.
sections.priorityMatrix: Catalog remediation matrix ordered by high-revenue SKU impact.
sections.actionPlan: Step-by-step product data cleanup and resubmission timeline.
sections.supportingEvidence: Item approval status tables, error code tallies, and product category breakdown charts.
sections.appendix: Merchant Center Account IDs, Catalog IDs, primary feed fetch URLs, and scheduled fetch frequencies.
